tools.name: list_services
tools.description: What North End Law offers through this server, at what fixed price, under which laws, and who is responsible. Responsible lawyer: Sergio Maldonado Elvira, Founder & Principal Attorney, North End Law Corporation, 447 Sutter St. Suite 506 - 1349, San Francisco, California 94108, United States.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: The facts a service needs, as a JSON Schema: service "dpa" (data processing agreement) or "baa" (business associate agreement). For a DPA, optionally narrowed to one governing law and the client's role. Do not send the facts until the engagement has begun.

tools.name: get_dpa_requirements
tools.description: The facts the data processing agreement needs, as a JSON Schema. Optionally narrowed to one governing law and the client's role. Do not send the facts until the engagement has begun.

tools.name: get_engagement_terms
tools.description: The full limited-scope engagement text for a service, with its version and SHA-256 hash, and whether it is open for acceptance.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: For anything outside the listed services: gives the booking link and lets the firm know a person would like to talk. Send a one-line topic only, no confidential facts.

tools.name: open_matter
tools.description: Starts a request for a data processing agreement ($350) or, with tool "baa", a business associate agreement ($350). tools.name: get_matter_status
tools.description: Where the matter stands, the next human step, the target in business hours, and any question from the lawyer.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: The firm's own card payment page for $350, available once the named person has accepted the engagement. The fee is charged in full at checkout and refunded in full if the firm declines the matter or does not deliver. The link is also e-mailed to the named person.
